website.error: Medical device company without drug pipeline; corporate site describes a single device program (Glucotrack CBGM)

commercial_product.type: Implantable continuous blood glucose monitor (medical device, not a drug)
commercial_product.indication: Type 1 diabetes and Type 2 diabetes using insulin or at risk for hypoglycemia
commercial_product.regulatory_status: Investigational device. First-in-human acute safety/performance study completed in 2025. Australian multicenter feasibility study was closed. Company plans IDE submission to FDA in Q2 2026 with US clinical trial program expected to launch in H2 2026 subject to FDA IDE approval. Not yet at pivotal stage; no active clinical study at snapshot date.
commercial_product.prior_product_note: First-generation Glucotrack non-invasive ear-clip device received CE Mark but CE Mark was withdrawn; commercialization discontinued.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Glucotrack is a single-product medical device company developing the implantable Glucotrack CBGM. The drug-trial Phase 1/2/3 framework does not apply; the device is regulated under the IDE/PMA pathway. The earlier Australian feasibility study has been closed, and the planned US IDE pivotal study is not yet active (IDE submission planned Q2 2026, study launch expected H2 2026). No active P1/P2/P3 drug trials.
